English.Char_Desc_250: Dice Trend Analyzer is a lightweight Windows utility for organizing and analyzing historical dice-result data, including frequencies, recurring patterns, session history and statistical trends through a simple desktop interface.
English.Char_Desc_450: Dice Trend Analyzer is a lightweight Windows desktop application for organizing, reviewing and analyzing historical dice-result data. It provides tools for reviewing frequencies, recurring patterns, session history, comparing recent results and studying statistical trends through a simple interface.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
Dice Trend Analyzer is a lightweight Windows desktop application designed to help users organize, review and analyze historical dice-result data.
The software provides a simple interface for entering previous results, reviewing session history, comparing recent outcomes, identifying recurring patterns and studying statistical trends.
Key features include recording historical dice results, analyzing result frequencies, comparing sessions, reviewing recurring patterns and studying statistical trends.
Dice Trend Analyzer is intended as an analytical and informational utility. Historical patterns and statistical observations do not guarantee future results.
Developed by ToolNova Apps for Windows 10 and Windows 11.
